definition: EO BMF rows in current monthly extract (eo1-eo4)
source: charity-network 04 (2026-11-09 file); eo1 re-sampled 2026-11-27: 281,266 rows
rationale: Prior full count; today's eo1 sample (281,266 rows, 0 duplicate EINs) consistent. The '~1.9M' working figure understates by ~4%
validation_method: Count rows of all four files at each monthly ingest

definition: 501(c)(3) organizations in BMF
rationale: Two independent derivations agree within 2%

definition: Distinct EIN entities in a normalized registry that keeps revoked/removed orgs
source: BMF 1,984,891 + revocation list 1,228,742 EINs minus ~34.5k overlap (eo1 measured 4,894 x 7.06); 990-N mostly overlaps BMF
rationale: Revoked orgs drop from BMF but must stay resolvable for history and reinstatement
validation_method: Union of EIN sets on first build

definition: Raw acquisition volume (bytes transferred) per year
source: beneficium-data-sources.csv; evidence/beneficium-public-data-notes.md
rationale: Base = BMF 12x0.35 + Pub78 12x0.03 + revocation 12x0.048 + 990-N 52x0.094 + 990 XML 4.5 + index 0.09 + OFAC adv XML ~120x0.134 + CSL 365x0.019 + FAC subset 12x0.347 + CA AG 24x0.003 + SAM exclusions placeholder 3.65 + misc. Low = directory scenario only. High adds NPPES (13.9), website snapshots (~80), USAspending API pulls and state feeds
validation_method: Log bytes per fetch for 3 months and compare

definition: Update bandwidth per month
rationale: Flat across months in bytes: the IRS republishes full files, so the August revocation surge does not raise bytes

definition: Compressed raw-archive growth per year (every version kept)
source: beneficium-data-sources.csv; evidence/beneficium-public-data-notes.md
rationale: Base: BMF 12x0.108 (3.2x ASSUMPTION) + Pub78 0.36 + revocation 0.57 + 990-N 4.9 + 990 XML 4.5 + OFAC 1.6 + CSL 1.5 + FAC 1.0 + SAM ~1 + misc. Low: row-level diffs instead of full snapshots and XML only for in-scope EINs. High: adds NPPES and website snapshots

definition: 990 e-file XML compressed bytes per filing year
rationale: Sum of Content-Length per year; growth ~2%/yr

definition: 990 e-file XML uncompressed expansion ratio
source: Sample 2025_TEOS_XML_10A.zip: 55.19 MB compressed members to 298.24 MB
rationale: One small batch; larger batches may differ slightly

definition: Historical retention: 10 years of 990 XML
source: BDZ-007 x 10 (base); IRS site holds 2019-2026 = 30.3 GB compressed
rationale: Low: keep only parsed Schedule A/I/R for in-scope EINs. Base: all ZIPs compressed. High: uncompressed (10 x 24 GB) plus growth. Pre-2019 years are no longer on IRS site (AWS bucket discontinued 2021); would need third-party mirrors

definition: Total 10-year retained storage (raw archive + XML + DB)
source: BDZ-006 non-XML x10 + BDZ-009 + BDZ-011 x (1+BDZ-012)
rationale: Base ~125 GB raw non-XML + 45 GB XML + ~17 GB DB with indexes. Prior charity-network 20 assumed 1 TB raw and 150 GB DB; both are above the base here
validation_method: Compare with storage bills after year 1

definition: Structured database size (normalized current state + temporal history + extracted 990 facts), year 1
source: Rows from BDZ-001/003; ~6.3M current-state rows x ~350 B = 2.2 GB; change history ~3.4M versions/yr x 400 B = 1.4 GB; 990 key facts 0.75M x 2 KB = 1.5 GB/yr; grant edges 1.7M x 300 B = 0.5 GB/yr; 2019-2025 backfill of facts ~5 GB
rationale: Bytes per row ASSUMPTION; high case stores full 990 XML as JSONB
validation_method: Load one month and measure pg_total_relation_size

definition: Index overhead factor on structured DB
source: Judgement for B-tree on EIN/dates plus trigram GIN on names for fuzzy match
rationale: Name-matching indexes dominate; no measurement

definition: Processing CPU-hours per month
source: Measured: byte-scan of 9,836 XML returns 1.5 CPU-s; parsing eo1 + eo_de + Pub78 + revocation (2.98M rows) 4.1 CPU-s
rationale: Parsing is minutes per month; base allows full DOM parse of ~65k returns/month (~10-20x scan cost), monthly BMF diff, sanctions name screening of ~2M names against ~50k list entries with blocking, and reprocessing. High covers full re-resolution runs and website crawling

definition: BMF organizations with any field change per month (all subsections)
source: charity-network 06 (2026-06 to 2026-07 diff)
rationale: One month measured; seasonal profile unknown

definition: 501(c)(3) change events per month: any field
source: charity-network 06
rationale: 80% informational (financial/tax period), 20% name/address only

definition: 501(c)(3) eligibility-relevant (material-adverse-candidate) field changes per month
source: charity-network 06: 405 (FOUNDATION 305, RULING 209, AFFILIATION 63, GROUP 55, DEDUCTIBILITY 53, SUBSECTION 42, STATUS 20; overlapping); ~90 truly adverse
rationale: Range covers seasonality not yet measured

definition: 501(c)(3) additions and removals per month
source: charity-network 06: 11,702 added + 3,617 removed
rationale: One month

definition: Auto-revocation postings per month (all subsections), non-August months
source: Measured 2026-11-27 on revocation file: 2026 Jan 118, Feb 2,319, Mar 5,318, Apr 1,077, May 1,452, Jun 766, Jul 684, Sep 1,195, Oct 463, Nov 902; Aug 38,826
rationale: August batch is ~70-73% of the year; annual 53-66k rows (2023-2026)

definition: Reinstatement rows added per month (average)
source: 184,830 reinstated rows in file covering 2011-2026 (~15.9 years)
rationale: Average only; timing uneven; 66% retroactive

definition: Population data-quality exceptions per month (rule or human), excluding August revocation surge
source: BDZ-016 (405) + Pub78/BMF conflicts (national stock ~1,140 presence and ~155 name conflicts from eo1 x 7.06; assumed 5-15% monthly churn) + revocation/reinstatement conflicts on BMF-listed orgs (~100)
rationale: Most are auto-classified by deterministic rules; only those touching an in-scope recipient need a person
validation_method: Count queue entries in replay harness

definition: Grant relationship rows per filing year from 990 Sch I and 990-PF
source: Sample 10A: 7,574 Sch I recipient rows + 15,097 PF grant rows in 9,836 returns; x76.1
rationale: Small October batch may not be representative

definition: Active recipients per sponsor (subset monitored closely)
source: competitive-displacement RP-01
rationale: Carried forward

definition: Eligibility-relevant change events per month among active subset
source: RP-02 change rate 2%/4%/8% per charity-year x BDZ-022 / 12
rationale: Low = 2% x 10k; base 4% x 20k; high 8% x 50k
validation_method: Replay harness on real recipient list

definition: Any-field BMF change events per month among active subset
source: BDZ-015 / BDZ-002 = 14%/month x BDZ-022
rationale: Mostly informational; auto-applied

definition: Revocations per month among active subset
source: charity-network 06: ~0.3% of grantees revoked per year x BDZ-022 / 12
rationale: Grantees are mostly filers so revocation incidence is far below population

definition: Human-handled data-quality exceptions per month among active subset
source: BDZ-023 with 60-70% deterministic auto-resolution plus name/EIN conflicts (~0.01% name conflict rate measured in NE Pub78/BMF)
rationale: Monitoring cases only; onboarding and renewal cases excluded

definition: Material source format/schema change events per year across federal sources
source: Observed 2021-2026: AWS 990 bucket retired and TEOS ZIP naming changed (2021-22); OFAC moved to Sanctions List Service; 2021-2024 990 ZIPs republished 2025-03-06; 990 page outage Nov 2025; hidden unlinked ZIP; CSL HEAD returns 404 while GET works; UK OFSI list closed 2026-01-28; plus 3-5 new IRS e-file schema versions/yr (8 versions in one 2025 batch)
rationale: Count of distinct breaking events ~8 over ~5 years plus annual XML schema releases
